recursive.status: RUN: 90 runs (9 scenarios x 10 held-out seeds) through the real runtime with real Crusoe via the gateway; a 14-worker replicate and a no-LLM runtime control were also run
recursive.definition: real orchestration runtime (monitor, SENTINEL graph, delegated tasks, frozen DOD contract, robot missions, independent verifier Layer A + SEN-05 Layer B) with the real Crusoe client through the inference gateway; in-process Stack, MemoryStorage/MemoryDecisionStore/InMemorySaver, never Neon
not_equalised: detection: runtime monitor persistence window (not the harness alarm scan + 60 s confirmation)
actuation: robot missions with real dispatch/travel time (not a fixed 120 s service latency)
the runtime replans and escalates by itself; it may also never open an incident for a fault class it has no detector for
claim time = the instant the runtime closes its incident(s) VERIFIED (the verifier window holds checks 28-55 sim s); truth is sampled at that instant
model latency is not simulated time (the sim waits for in-flight calls), same as the single-pass arm

memory_ablation.design: OFF = recursive arm rows (MEMORY_ENABLED=0); OFF2 = an identical OFF replicate (noise floor); ON = brain pre-trained on DEV seeds only (3 seeds, verified outcomes only), private copy per held-out run; same plant, scenarios, held-out seeds, gateway limits and budgets
memory_ablation.verdict: NO MEASURABLE DIFFERENCE: every paired run has the identical verified-completion outcome with memory ON and OFF
